name: fe_serve_start
description: Start a static file server for the session working directory (or `dir`) on an ephemeral localhost port. Returns the port and serving directory. The user's app shows a live preview (miniscreen) of this directory with hot reload. Use this when the task involves previewing or iterating on frontend code — the handler IS the server.

dir.description: Directory to serve (defaults to the session working directory)

name: fe_serve_status
description: List running servers: directory, port, started time, and which file the live preview currently shows (activeFile). Also reports the session working directory.

name: fe_serve_list
description: List the HTML files served by the server for `dir` (defaults to the session working directory): relative name, URL, size and last-modified time, plus activeFile (the file the live preview currently shows). Use this to verify what the user can see in the preview and to enumerate generated artifacts.

dir.description: Directory whose server to inspect (defaults to the session working directory)

name: fe_serve_show
description: Point the live preview (miniscreen) at a specific file inside the served directory, e.g. "index.html" or "viz/03.html". The user's preview navigates to it automatically. Use when you want the user to look at a particular artifact you produced.

dir.description: Directory whose server to direct (defaults to the session working directory)

file.description: Path of the file to show, relative to the served directory, e.g. "index.html" or "viz/03.html"

name: fe_serve_stop
description: Stop the server serving `dir` (defaults to the session working directory).

dir.description: Directory whose server to stop (defaults to the session working directory)

name: fe_serve_logs
description: Return the last `limit` log lines of the static server (requests served, errors).

limit.description: Number of recent log lines, default 50, max 200.
